item.title: Saudi Arabia Gold price today: Gold rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices rose in Saudi Arabia on Friday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: Asian stocks trade mixed, South Korea’s KOSPI falls 1.20%
item.description: Asian equities trade mixed on Friday after a turbulent session for global markets as the conflict in the Middle East ‌showed few signs of easing.

item.title: Gold rises but remains on track for weekly loss in five weeks
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) recovers its recent losses from the previous session on Friday. The yellow metal advances as the broader precious metals market rebounds on safe-haven demand.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD jumps above $84.00 on safe-haven demand, US NFP data looms
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) trades higher on Friday, climbing toward $84.25 at the time of writing, gaining 2.80% on the day. The precious metal gains momentum as ongoing geopolitical tensions provide some support to the safe-haven asset.

item.title: USD/INR drops at open, outlook remains firm amid higher oil prices, FIIs selling
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) trades higher against the US Dollar (USD) in the opening trade on Friday.

item.title: Japanese Yen underperforms as Iran conflict prompts BoJ policy uncertainty
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) trades lower against its major currency peers, with the USD/JPY pair rising to near 157.75, in the late Asian trade on Friday.

item.title: USD/CHF remains subdued near 0.7800 as US Dollar steadies on recent gains
item.description: USD/CHF inches lower after registering 0.25% gains in the previous session, trading around 0.7810 during the Asian hours on Friday.

item.title: Japan’s Katayama: Government ready to act to combat economic impact from Iran conflict
item.description: Japan’s Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said on Friday that compiling extra budget would of course be an option as Prime Minister had said before. Katayama added that the government ready to take steps in timely fashion to combat economic impact from Iran conflict.
